description: Ask for authorization BEFORE doing anything consequential (deleting data, deploying, spending, sending). Atlas checks the action and its effects against the signed delegation chain and returns permit, deny or escalate with a receipt_id. Do not perform the action unless the decision is permit (or escalate that a human later approved).

agent.description: Your agent id, as named in the last delegation grant

effects.description: Every effect the action will have. Be complete and honest.

type.description: read | write | create | delete | exec | send | spend (free-form)

principal.description: The human or system that originally delegated authority

name: atlas_authorize
title: Authorize Action
